SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7381
Section 1, Special Branch Station /
REPORT
Date August 17, 19
Subject: Communication No 12-0-33 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mrs. Vachtel and Miss Lyra Vachtel.
Made by. Jos. Prokofiev Forwarded by. C Crawford 8 8

Mrs Maria Prokopievna VACHTEL ( VACHTEL) nee
Kazaroff, Estonian of Russian origin, was born on Janu-
ary 10, 1898 at Nagasaki. She is reported to have arrived
in Shanghai from Hankow in November, 1926 together with
her daughter Lyra born on 7-11-1921 in Russia. When re-
gistering with the Russian Emigrants Committee she gave
her place of birth as Khabarovsk, Maritime Province, and
stated that prior to coming to Shanghai she resided in
Hankow for six months, her former residence since 1922
being Tientsin.

In May, 1929 she applied to local Estonian repre-
sentative for passport stating that she was an Estonian
by marriage. Her late husband, Mr. Arthur Vachtel, who
formerly resided in the Russian Far East, died in 1926 at
Reval where he was employed with a Finnish firm. With
the assistance of local Finnish vice-consul Mrs Vachtel
was able to establish her claim to the Estonian nationa-
lity and on 5-6-29 was issued with passport No 15528/28
which has since been regularly renewed.

In Shanghai Mrs Vachtel resided mostly in the
French Concession. From 1932 to 1936 she was manageress
of a ladies' beauty parlour at 1211 Bubbling Well Road,
after which she resided in a small flat at 28 Route
Winling until November, 15, 1938 when she left for Penang
in the m/v "Gneisenau" together with her daughter. They
travelled Tourist Class. According to information receiv-
ed confidentially from local Estonian consul, she was not
very well off financially and it is likely that she was

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7381
特务科第一节 /
报告
日期：19__年8月17日
事由：英国总领事馆关于瓦赫特尔夫人（Mrs. Vachtel）和莱拉·瓦赫特尔小姐（Miss Lyra Vachtel）的第12-0-33号公函。
制作人：约瑟夫·普罗科菲耶夫（Jos. Prokofiev） 转呈人：C. 克劳福德（C Crawford） 8 8

玛丽亚·普罗科皮耶夫娜·瓦赫特尔（Maria Prokopievna VACHTEL，娘家姓卡扎罗夫 Kazaroff），俄裔爱沙尼亚人，1898年1月10日出生于长崎。据报，她与其女儿莱拉（Lyra，1921年11月7日出生于俄罗斯）于1926年11月从汉口抵达上海。在向俄国难民委员会登记时，她申报的出生地为滨海省哈巴罗夫斯克，并声称在来上海之前曾在汉口居住六个月，其自1922年起的前居住地是天津。

1929年5月，她向当地爱沙尼亚代表申请护照，称其因婚姻关系取得爱沙尼亚国籍。其已故丈夫阿瑟·瓦赫特尔先生（Mr. Arthur Vachtel）此前居住在俄国远东地区，1926年在雷瓦尔（Reval）去世，生前受雇于一家芬兰公司。在当地芬兰副领事的协助下，瓦赫特尔夫人得以确立其爱沙尼亚国籍主张，并于1929年6月5日获发第15528/28号护照，此后该护照定期续期。

在上海期间，瓦赫特尔夫人主要居住在法租界。1932年至1936年，她担任静安寺路1211号一家女子美容院的经理，此后居住在温林路（Route Winling）28号的一间小公寓内，直至1938年11月15日与女儿一同乘坐“格奈森瑙”号（m/v "Gneisenau"）轮船前往槟城。她们乘坐的是三等舱。根据从当地爱沙尼亚领事处秘密获得的信息，她的经济状况并不宽裕，很可能由一位男性朋友资助。

    In 1935 and 1936 Mrs Vachtel is reported to
have visited Hongkong where her sister, Mrs L.P. Verigo,
52 has been residing since 1934 together with her two
daughters and son. The latter, Mr. V.V.Verigo, has been
employed with the Hongkong Police for about ten years and
is a naturalized British subject.
    Mrs Vachtel's elder brother, S.P. Nabaroff, ex-
officer of the Russian army, holds the rank of Lieutenant
in the Russian Auxiliary Detachment of the French Police
in Shanghai, in which he has been serving for the past se-
veral years.
    Nothing detrimental is known at the local Es-
thonian Consulate regarding Mrs Vachtel and her daughter.
While in Shanghai they did not come to Police notice.

                                A. Prokofiev
                                D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号 ____

报告    分局，____
          日期 ____ 19__
事由。____ - 2 -

制作人。____ 转呈人。____

有一位男性朋友资助。
    据报，瓦赫特尔夫人曾于1935年和1936年访问香港，她的姐姐L.P.韦里戈夫人（Mrs L.P. Verigo，52岁）自1934年以来一直与其两个女儿和一个儿子居住在香港。其子V.V.韦里戈先生（Mr. V.V.Verigo）已在香港警队任职约十年，并已归化成为英国臣民。
    瓦赫特尔夫人的长兄S.P.纳巴罗夫（S.P. Nabaroff），前俄国军队军官，在上海法国警察局的俄国辅助分队中担任中尉军衔，过去几年一直在此服役。
    当地爱沙尼亚领事馆方面，未发现有关瓦赫特尔夫人及其女儿的任何不利记录。她们在上海期间未引起警方注意。

                                A. 普罗科菲耶夫（A. Prokofiev）
                                D. S. I.

副 commissioner （特务科）。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL. 9381
P.O. BOX 289. SHANGHAI.

August 12th, 1939.

My dear Robertson,

Recently a Mrs. AGNES P. VACHTEL and her
daughter KYRA ( Esthonians ), arrived in Singapore
from Shanghai. I am told that Mrs. Vachtel is
half Japanese and as far as the authorities in
Singapore can make out they appear to be living
on their wits.

If there is any record of these two indivi-
duals on your files I should be most grateful if
you would let me have any information available.

Yours sincerely,
〔此处为手写签名〕

T. Robertson, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
185 Foochow Rd,
SHANGHAI

〔此处有手写批注：81/412〕
〔此处有手写批注：I. S. J. Parkinson 6 12/8〕

英国总领事馆。 9381
邮政信箱 289，上海。

1939年8月12日。

亲爱的罗伯逊：

最近，阿格尼丝·P·瓦赫特尔夫人（Mrs. AGNES P. VACHTEL）及其女儿基拉（KYRA）（爱沙尼亚人）从上海抵达新加坡。我获悉瓦赫特尔夫人有一半日本血统，据新加坡当局查明，她们似乎靠耍小聪明谋生。

如果你的档案中有关于这两个人的任何记录，若能提供现有信息，我将不胜感激。

此致，
〔此处为手写签名〕

T. 罗伯逊先生（T. Robertson, Esq.），
警务处副处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路185号，
上海

〔此处有手写批注：81/412〕
〔此处有手写批注：I. S. J. 帕金森（Parkinson） 6 12/8〕
